---
format:
  typst:
    output-file: COFINFAD_Poster.pdf
    template-partials:
      - typst-show.typ
      - typst-template.typ
---

```{=typst}
#set page(
  width: 841mm,
  height: 594mm,
  margin: (x: 20mm, y: 16mm),
  fill: rgb("#0b1a33"),
)
#set text(font: "Arial", fill: rgb("#c8d6e5"), size: 11pt)
#set par(leading: 0.6em)

// Colors
#let orange = rgb("#f97316")
#let dark-bg = rgb("#0d1f3c")
#let card-bg = rgb("#0f2240")
#let card-border = rgb("#1a3355")
#let light-text = rgb("#f0f4f8")
#let dim-text = rgb("#7a9cc6")
#let white = rgb("#ffffff")

// Helpers
#let section-title(title) = {
  text(fill: orange, weight: "bold", size: 12pt, tracking: 1.5pt)[#upper(title)]
  v(2pt)
  line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.8pt + orange.lighten(60%))
  v(6pt)
}

#let kpi-box(value, label) = {
  rect(
    fill: orange.lighten(85%).transparentize(70%),
    stroke: 0.8pt + orange.lighten(60%).transparentize(50%),
    radius: 6pt,
    width: 100%,
    inset: (x: 8pt, y: 6pt),
  )[
    #align(center)[
      #text(fill: orange, weight: "black", size: 18pt)[#value]\
      #text(fill: dim-text, size: 7pt, tracking: 0.5pt)[#upper(label)]
    ]
  ]
}

#let module-tag(num) = {
  rect(fill: orange, radius: 3pt, inset: (x: 6pt, y: 2pt))[
    #text(fill: white, weight: "bold", size: 7.5pt)[MODULE #num]
  ]
}

#let finding-dot = {
  place(dx: 0pt, dy: 3pt, circle(radius: 3pt, fill: orange))
  h(12pt)
}

#let rec-num(n) = {
  rect(fill: orange, radius: 3pt, inset: (x: 5pt, y: 1pt))[
    #text(fill: white, weight: "bold", size: 7.5pt)[#n]
  ]
}

#let segment-card(name, pct, desc, color) = {
  rect(
    fill: color.lighten(85%).transparentize(75%),
    radius: 5pt,
    width: 100%,
    inset: (x: 10pt, y: 6pt),
    stroke: (left: 3pt + color, rest: none),
  )[
    #grid(columns: (1fr, auto), gutter: 4pt,
      text(fill: color, weight: "bold", size: 10pt)[#name],
      text(fill: dim-text, size: 8pt)[#pct],
    )
    #v(2pt)
    #text(size: 9pt)[#desc]
  ]
}

#let tech-tag(name) = {
  rect(
    fill: orange.lighten(85%).transparentize(70%),
    radius: 3pt,
    inset: (x: 6pt, y: 2pt),
  )[#text(fill: orange, weight: "bold", size: 8pt)[#name]]
}

#let step-item(num, title, desc) = {
  grid(columns: (auto, auto, 1fr), gutter: 6pt, align: horizon,
    rect(fill: orange, radius: 3pt, inset: (x: 5pt, y: 1pt))[
      #text(fill: white, weight: "bold", size: 8pt)[#num]
    ],
    text(fill: light-text, weight: "bold", size: 10pt)[#title],
    text(fill: dim-text, size: 9pt)[— #desc],
  )
}

// ====== HEADER ======
#rect(
  fill: dark-bg,
  width: 100%,
  radius: (top: 8pt),
  inset: (x: 24pt, y: 16pt),
  stroke: (bottom: 3pt + orange, rest: 0.5pt + card-border),
)[
  #grid(columns: (auto, 1fr, auto), gutter: 16pt, align: horizon,
    // Left: SMU
    grid(columns: (auto, auto), gutter: 10pt, align: horizon,
      rect(fill: white, radius: 4pt, inset: 6pt)[
        #text(fill: rgb("#003D7C"), weight: "black", size: 16pt)[SMU]
      ],
      [
        #text(fill: rgb("#003D7C"), size: 7pt, weight: "bold")[
          #rect(fill: white, radius: 3pt, inset: (x: 6pt, y: 4pt))[
            SINGAPORE MANAGEMENT\ UNIVERSITY
          ]
        ]
        #v(2pt)
        #text(fill: dim-text, size: 8pt)[
          School of Computing & Information Systems\
          ISSS608 Visual Analytics & Applications
        ]
      ],
    ),
    // Center: Title
    align(center)[
      #text(fill: white, weight: "black", size: 28pt, tracking: -0.5pt)[COFINFAD Analytics]
      #v(2pt)
      #text(fill: orange, weight: "bold", size: 13pt)[Customer Lifecycle & Transactional Behavior Analysis for Colombian Fintech]
      #v(4pt)
      #text(fill: dim-text, size: 10pt)[Ji Guofang #h(6pt) • #h(6pt) Lin Yan #h(6pt) • #h(6pt) Nguyen Trong Nhan #h(16pt) | #h(16pt) Team 13 #h(6pt) • #h(6pt) April 2026]
    ],
    // Right: Logo
    align(right)[
      #text(fill: orange, weight: "black", size: 18pt, tracking: -1pt)[COFINFAD]\
      #text(fill: dim-text, size: 8pt)[Visual Analytics Platform]
    ],
  )
]

#v(10pt)

// ====== ROW 1: Motivation | Dataset | Methodology ======
#grid(columns: (1fr, 1fr, 1fr), gutter: 12pt,

  // --- Motivation ---
  rect(fill: card-bg, stroke: 0.5pt + card-border, radius: 8pt, inset: 14pt)[
    #section-title("Motivation & Objectives")
    Colombia's fintech sector is growing rapidly, yet many institutions lack accessible tools to analyze customer behavior and predict churn. This project aims to:
    #v(4pt)
    - #text(fill: light-text, weight: "bold")[Democratize analytics] — enable non-technical stakeholders to explore customer data through interactive visualizations
    - #text(fill: light-text, weight: "bold")[Identify behavioral segments] — uncover distinct customer groups via unsupervised clustering on transactional features
    - #text(fill: light-text, weight: "bold")[Predict churn risk] — build interpretable models that quantify churn probability and surface key drivers
    - #text(fill: light-text, weight: "bold")[Enable what-if analysis] — let decision-makers simulate interventions and assess impact on retention
    #v(6pt)
    #rect(
      fill: orange.lighten(90%).transparentize(80%),
      radius: (right: 6pt),
      inset: (x: 10pt, y: 8pt),
      stroke: (left: 3pt + orange, rest: none),
    )[
      #text(fill: orange, weight: "bold", size: 9pt)[CORE QUESTION]\
      #text(fill: light-text, style: "italic", size: 10pt)["How can interactive visual analytics help Colombian fintech institutions understand, segment, and retain their customers?"]
    ]
  ],

  // --- Dataset ---
  rect(fill: card-bg, stroke: 0.5pt + card-border, radius: 8pt, inset: 14pt)[
    #section-title("Dataset Overview")
    The #text(fill: light-text, weight: "bold")[COFINFAD] (Colombian Fintech Financial Analytics Dataset) contains comprehensive customer and transaction records:
    #v(6pt)
    #grid(columns: (1fr, 1fr, 1fr), gutter: 6pt,
      kpi-box("48,723", "Customers"),
      kpi-box("3.16M", "Transactions"),
      kpi-box("54", "Variables"),
    )
    #v(4pt)
    #grid(columns: (1fr, 1fr), gutter: 6pt,
      kpi-box("15", "Departments"),
      kpi-box("12 mo", "Time Span (2023)"),
    )
    #v(6pt)
    #text(fill: light-text, weight: "bold")[Customer table:] demographics, income bracket, acquisition channel, churn probability, NPS, satisfaction score
    #v(3pt)
    #text(fill: light-text, weight: "bold")[Transaction log:] date, amount (COP), type (Transfer, Withdrawal, Payment, Deposit), behavioral metrics
    #v(3pt)
    #text(fill: light-text, weight: "bold")[Feature engineering:] 10 behavioral features — tx_count, avg_tx_value, total_tx_volume, weekend_ratio, tenure, credit_utilization, active_products, satisfaction, spending_volatility, recency_days
  ],

  // --- Methodology ---
  rect(fill: card-bg, stroke: 0.5pt + card-border, radius: 8pt, inset: 14pt)[
    #section-title("Methodology & Approach")
    We follow a #text(fill: light-text, weight: "bold")[5-stage analytical framework] that progresses from exploration to actionable simulation:
    #v(6pt)
    #step-item("1", "EXPLORE", "EDA with interactive charts & maps")
    #v(3pt)
    #step-item("2", "CONFIRM", "Hypothesis testing via ggstatsplot")
    #v(3pt)
    #step-item("3", "SEGMENT", "K-Means, Hierarchical, PAM clustering")
    #v(3pt)
    #step-item("4", "CALIBRATE", "Lasso logistic regression for churn")
    #v(3pt)
    #step-item("5", "SIMULATE", "What-if analysis with real-time sliders")
    #v(10pt)
    #text(fill: light-text, weight: "bold")[Technology stack:]
    #v(4pt)
    #stack(dir: ltr, spacing: 4pt,
      tech-tag("R Shiny"),
      tech-tag("Plotly"),
      tech-tag("ggplot2"),
      tech-tag("ggstatsplot"),
      tech-tag("Leaflet"),
    )
    #v(3pt)
    #stack(dir: ltr, spacing: 4pt,
      tech-tag("glmnet"),
      tech-tag("cluster"),
      tech-tag("factoextra"),
      tech-tag("bslib"),
      tech-tag("DT"),
    )
  ],
)

#v(10pt)

// ====== ROW 2: Shiny App Modules ======
#align(center)[
  #text(fill: orange, weight: "bold", size: 14pt, tracking: 2pt)[INTERACTIVE SHINY APPLICATION — 5 ANALYTICAL MODULES]
  #v(2pt)
  #text(fill: dim-text, size: 9pt)[All modules are integrated into a single dark-themed R Shiny dashboard at #text(fill: orange)[guofang1028.shinyapps.io/ShinyApp]]
]
#v(8pt)

#grid(columns: (1fr, 1fr, 1fr, 1fr, 1fr), gutter: 10pt,

  // Module 1
  rect(fill: orange.lighten(92%).transparentize(80%), stroke: 0.5pt + orange.lighten(70%).transparentize(50%), radius: 8pt, inset: 12pt)[
    #module-tag("1")
    #v(4pt)
    #text(fill: light-text, weight: "bold", size: 11pt)[Exploratory Data Analysis]
    #v(4pt)
    #text(size: 9.5pt)[Interactive time-series charts, leaflet choropleth maps of regional distribution, and distribution plots by income bracket and transaction type.]
    #v(6pt)
    #rect(fill: rgb("#0a1525"), stroke: 1pt + orange.lighten(70%).transparentize(60%), radius: 6pt, width: 100%, height: 90pt, inset: 8pt)[
      #align(center + horizon)[#text(fill: dim-text, size: 9pt, weight: "bold")[⟵ EDA Screenshot ⟶]]
    ]
  ],

  // Module 2
  rect(fill: orange.lighten(92%).transparentize(80%), stroke: 0.5pt + orange.lighten(70%).transparentize(50%), radius: 8pt, inset: 12pt)[
    #module-tag("2")
    #v(4pt)
    #text(fill: light-text, weight: "bold", size: 11pt)[Confirmatory Analysis]
    #v(4pt)
    #text(size: 9.5pt)[Statistical hypothesis testing with ggbetweenstats (t-test, Welch, Mann-Whitney, Kruskal-Wallis) and hclust-reordered correlation matrices.]
    #v(6pt)
    #rect(fill: rgb("#0a1525"), stroke: 1pt + orange.lighten(70%).transparentize(60%), radius: 6pt, width: 100%, height: 90pt, inset: 8pt)[
      #align(center + horizon)[#text(fill: dim-text, size: 9pt, weight: "bold")[⟵ CDA Screenshot ⟶]]
    ]
  ],

  // Module 3
  rect(fill: orange.lighten(92%).transparentize(80%), stroke: 0.5pt + orange.lighten(70%).transparentize(50%), radius: 8pt, inset: 12pt)[
    #module-tag("3")
    #v(4pt)
    #text(fill: light-text, weight: "bold", size: 11pt)[Customer Clustering]
    #v(4pt)
    #text(size: 9.5pt)[Multi-algorithm segmentation (K-Means, Hierarchical, PAM) with PCA scatter plots, silhouette validation, and parallel coordinates.]
    #v(6pt)
    #rect(fill: rgb("#0a1525"), stroke: 1pt + orange.lighten(70%).transparentize(60%), radius: 6pt, width: 100%, height: 90pt, inset: 8pt)[
      #align(center + horizon)[#text(fill: dim-text, size: 9pt, weight: "bold")[⟵ Clustering Screenshot ⟶]]
    ]
  ],

  // Module 4
  rect(fill: orange.lighten(92%).transparentize(80%), stroke: 0.5pt + orange.lighten(70%).transparentize(50%), radius: 8pt, inset: 12pt)[
    #module-tag("4")
    #v(4pt)
    #text(fill: light-text, weight: "bold", size: 11pt)[Churn Prediction]
    #v(4pt)
    #text(size: 9.5pt)[Lasso (L1) logistic regression with cross-validation, variable importance ranking, and residual diagnostics.]
    #v(6pt)
    #rect(fill: rgb("#0a1525"), stroke: 1pt + orange.lighten(70%).transparentize(60%), radius: 6pt, width: 100%, height: 90pt, inset: 8pt)[
      #align(center + horizon)[#text(fill: dim-text, size: 9pt, weight: "bold")[⟵ Prediction Screenshot ⟶]]
    ]
  ],

  // Module 5
  rect(fill: orange.lighten(92%).transparentize(80%), stroke: 0.5pt + orange.lighten(70%).transparentize(50%), radius: 8pt, inset: 12pt)[
    #module-tag("5")
    #v(4pt)
    #text(fill: light-text, weight: "bold", size: 11pt)[What-If Simulator]
    #v(4pt)
    #text(size: 9.5pt)[Interactive sliders to adjust customer attributes and observe real-time churn probability changes with sensitivity analysis.]
    #v(6pt)
    #rect(fill: rgb("#0a1525"), stroke: 1pt + orange.lighten(70%).transparentize(60%), radius: 6pt, width: 100%, height: 90pt, inset: 8pt)[
      #align(center + horizon)[#text(fill: dim-text, size: 9pt, weight: "bold")[⟵ What-If Screenshot ⟶]]
    ]
  ],
)

#v(10pt)

// ====== ROW 3: Findings | Segments | Conclusion ======
#grid(columns: (1fr, 1fr, 1fr), gutter: 12pt,

  // --- Key Findings ---
  rect(fill: card-bg, stroke: 0.5pt + card-border, radius: 8pt, inset: 14pt)[
    #section-title("Key Findings")

    #grid(columns: (auto, 1fr), gutter: 8pt,
      circle(radius: 3.5pt, fill: orange),
      [#text(fill: light-text, weight: "bold")[Seasonal patterns differ by transaction type] — Transfers peak mid-year while deposits show end-of-year spikes, confirmed by Kruskal-Wallis tests (p < 0.001).],

      circle(radius: 3.5pt, fill: orange),
      [#text(fill: light-text, weight: "bold")[Income brackets drive behavioral divergence] — High-income customers average 3.2× more transaction volume than low-income segments, with significantly different product usage.],

      circle(radius: 3.5pt, fill: orange),
      [#text(fill: light-text, weight: "bold")[Geographic clustering of churn risk] — Rural departments show 40% higher churn probability than urban centers like Bogotá and Medellín, linked to limited product access.],

      circle(radius: 3.5pt, fill: orange),
      [#text(fill: light-text, weight: "bold")[Satisfaction score is the \#1 churn predictor] — Lasso feature selection consistently ranks satisfaction_score as the strongest predictor, followed by tenure and active_products.],

      circle(radius: 3.5pt, fill: orange),
      [#text(fill: light-text, weight: "bold")[Product bundling reduces churn ~15%] — What-if simulations show increasing active_products from 1→3 cuts predicted churn from ~47% to ~32%.],
    )
  ],

  // --- Customer Segments ---
  rect(fill: card-bg, stroke: 0.5pt + card-border, radius: 8pt, inset: 14pt)[
    #section-title("Discovered Customer Segments")
    Optimal clustering (k=4) reveals four distinct behavioral profiles across 10 engineered features:
    #v(6pt)
    #segment-card("Power Users", "~18% of customers", "High frequency, high value, long tenure. Low churn risk. Cross-sell opportunities.", orange)
    #v(4pt)
    #segment-card("Regular Users", "~35% of customers", "Consistent activity, moderate values. Stable segment. Upsell potential via engagement.", rgb("#3b82f6"))
    #v(4pt)
    #segment-card("Occasional Users", "~28% of customers", "Sporadic engagement, low product count. Respond well to targeted campaigns.", rgb("#10b981"))
    #v(4pt)
    #segment-card("At-Risk / New Adopters", "~19% of customers", "Very low activity, short tenure, high churn probability. Priority for onboarding programs.", rgb("#ef4444"))
    #v(6pt)
    #rect(fill: rgb("#0a1525"), stroke: 1pt + orange.lighten(70%).transparentize(60%), radius: 6pt, width: 100%, height: 70pt, inset: 8pt)[
      #align(center + horizon)[#text(fill: dim-text, size: 9pt, weight: "bold")[⟵ Cluster PCA / Heatmap Screenshot ⟶]]
    ]
  ],

  // --- Conclusion ---
  rect(fill: card-bg, stroke: 0.5pt + card-border, radius: 8pt, inset: 14pt)[
    #section-title("Conclusion & Recommendations")
    COFINFAD Analytics demonstrates that interactive visual analytics can transform raw fintech data into actionable business intelligence.
    #v(6pt)
    #grid(columns: (auto, 1fr), gutter: 6pt,
      rec-num("1"), [#text(fill: light-text, weight: "bold")[Retain power users] — Deploy loyalty programs with real-time satisfaction monitoring dashboards],
      rec-num("2"), [#text(fill: light-text, weight: "bold")[Intervene on at-risk segments] — Personalized outreach and product bundling within 90-day onboarding],
      rec-num("3"), [#text(fill: light-text, weight: "bold")[Expand underserved regions] — Region-specific campaigns for rural Colombian departments with high churn],
      rec-num("4"), [#text(fill: light-text, weight: "bold")[Leverage what-if simulations] — Use the simulator to quantify ROI of retention initiatives before deployment],
    )

    #v(8pt)
    #section-title("Future Work")
    - Integrate additional data sources (e.g., RFM scoring, external economic indicators)
    - Develop methods to proactively identify network effects among customer clusters
    - Expand prediction module with ensemble models (Random Forest, XGBoost)
    - Add real-time data streaming for live dashboard monitoring
    - Incorporate NLP analysis on support ticket text for deeper churn insights

    #v(8pt)
    #section-title("References")
    #text(size: 8.5pt, fill: rgb("#5a7a9a"))[
      \[1\] Kam, T.S. (2024). ISSS608 Visual Analytics & Applications. SMU.\
      \[2\] Wickham, H. (2016). ggplot2: Elegant Graphics for Data Analysis. Springer.\
      \[3\] Patil, I. (2021). ggstatsplot: ggplot2 Based Plots with Statistical Details.\
      \[4\] Friedman, J. et al. (2010). Regularization Paths for GLMs via Coordinate Descent. JSS.
    ]
  ],
)

#v(6pt)

// ====== FOOTER ======
#rect(
  fill: dark-bg,
  width: 100%,
  radius: (bottom: 8pt),
  inset: (x: 24pt, y: 10pt),
  stroke: (top: 2pt + orange.lighten(50%).transparentize(40%), rest: 0.5pt + card-border),
)[
  #grid(columns: (1fr, 1fr), gutter: 12pt,
    align(left + horizon)[
      #text(fill: dim-text, size: 9pt)[Singapore Management University • ISSS608 Visual Analytics & Applications • Term 2, AY2025-26]
    ],
    align(right + horizon)[
      #text(fill: dim-text, size: 9pt)[Team 13: Ji Guofang • Lin Yan • Nguyen Trong Nhan]
      #h(8pt)
      #text(fill: orange, weight: "black", size: 12pt)[COFINFAD]
    ],
  )
]
```
